sentences.text: Aerial drone shot of The Harborne Hospital, a white and blue-glass building, moving slowly towards it, with neighbouring hospital buildings, roads, car parks and the Birmingham skyline around it.

Aerial drone shot of The Harborne Hospital exterior, a white and blue-glass building beside a curved access road, with neighbouring hospital buildings, a solar-panelled car park and the Birmingham suburbs behind. The camera moves around the building as cars pass on the road below.
Aerial drone shot of The Harborne Hospital, a white and blue-glass building, moving around it with the curved neighbouring hospital building, roads, car parks and Birmingham suburbs in view.

Aerial drone shot drifting past a multi-storey hospital building with blue and white cladding on a city hospital campus, with a curved tower in the foreground, an elevated walkway, a car park and a residential area beyond.

Aerial drone shot of The Harborne Hospital, a white and blue glass building beside a curved access road, with a solar-panel-covered car park in the foreground and surrounding hospital campus buildings and green space behind. The drone moves slowly toward the building on a clear, sunny day.

Aerial drone shot of The Harborne Hospital building and its surroundings, with the camera moving slowly toward the white and blue-clad building and its curved front driveway. Solar-panel covered car parking sits in the foreground, with parkland and neighbouring buildings and towers around the site.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a hospital campus, showing curved multi-storey ward towers, a white and glass-fronted building, an elevated covered walkway, car parks and surrounding green space. No signage is legible, so the frame does not confirm which building is The Harborne Hospital.

Aerial drone shot slowly moving across a large hospital campus with curved multi-storey ward blocks, a glass-fronted building linked by an elevated walkway, and surrounding car parks and green space. No signage confirms which hospital is shown, so check that this is The Harborne Hospital and not a neighbouring site before use.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a hospital campus, showing a curved multi-storey hospital building linked by an elevated walkway to a glass-fronted block, with car parks, paths and green fields around it. No signage is legible, so the specific buildings cannot be confirmed from the footage.

Aerial drone shot slowly moving over a hospital campus, showing multi-storey hospital buildings linked by a long elevated covered footbridge, with car parks, a construction site and rooftop solar panels below.

Aerial drone shot moving slowly over a hospital campus. It shows a white building with blue glass upper floors, a long elevated covered walkway, surface car parks, a construction site and surrounding medical buildings.
Overhead drone shot of The Harborne Hospital site, moving slowly over a car park, an elevated covered walkway between buildings, rooftop solar panels and a crane on an active construction area.

Overhead drone shot looking down on The Harborne Hospital campus, showing a building with rooftop solar panels, a car park, a long covered walkway and an active construction site with a crane next to the hospital buildings.

A nurse in a burgundy tunic reads from notes during a shift handover at a ward nurses' station, briefing two colleagues seen from behind in the foreground. Computer screens and monitors sit on the desk behind her.

Two staff members in burgundy uniforms in an imaging control room. A woman stands reading aloud from a notebook while a seated male colleague listens, with scan images displayed on workstation monitors behind them.

In an MRI control room, a staff member in a maroon uniform holds paperwork and talks to two colleagues, one seated at the scanner workstation and one in the foreground. The MRI scanner is partly visible through the control room window.

A staff member in a maroon tunic holds papers and briefs colleagues in a CT control room, with the scanner visible through the window behind her. The shot is over the shoulders of team members in maroon uniforms, with one seated at the workstation.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic studies a cardiac CT scan on a workstation monitor and points to the heart and aorta on the image, while a female colleague in matching uniform looks on in the imaging control room, with lead aprons hanging on the wall behind.

In an imaging control room, a staff member in a maroon uniform looks at CT scan images on a monitor while the camera moves past him to reveal a colleague in glasses reading through paperwork in a folder, pen in hand.

A nurse in a maroon tunic and glasses goes through paperwork with a pen while explaining it to two colleagues in matching uniforms, at a ward base with notices on the wall behind them. The camera moves past a colleague in the foreground to show the team discussion.

Two nurses in burgundy uniforms talk through notes at a ward nurses' station, with a third colleague joining from the right edge of frame. The woman holds a notebook while the man speaks to the group in front of a staff noticeboard and wall clock.
Three nurses in maroon uniforms talk together at The Harborne Hospital, with a nurse in glasses speaking while a male colleague listens. It looks like a team discussion or handover.

A nurse in a burgundy uniform talks with a male colleague, then writes on a paper chart on a clipboard while standing by a window with blinds. The colleague is in the blurred foreground with his back to camera.

Two nurses in burgundy uniforms talk at a nurses' station at The Harborne Hospital. The female nurse, wearing glasses, holds a paper chart and pen and listens to her male colleague, who is seen from behind in the foreground.
A radiographer in a maroon tunic and blue gloves uses the touchscreen control panel on a Siemens SOMATOM Force CT scanner, preparing the scanner in a CT room at The Harborne Hospital.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic stands beside a Siemens CT scanner and talks while a patient lies on the scanner table with her head near the gantry. The camera moves in from a wide view of the imaging room to a closer shot of the radiographer and the lit gantry ring.

A staff member in a maroon tunic stands beside a Siemens SOMATOM Force CT scanner and speaks to camera while a patient lies on the scanner table. The camera pushes in from a wide view of the CT suite to a medium shot of the speaker.

Close-up of a hand pressing the control dial on an MRI scanner's touchscreen panel, which shows a patient positioning diagram, at The Harborne Hospital. Staff set up the scan from the panel on the scanner.

A patient lies on the table of a Siemens SOMATOM CT scanner and moves into the bore while a radiographer presses the controls on the gantry. A leg support cushion is visible on the table as the scan begins.
A female patient lies inside a scanner bore lit with purple light, with her arm resting above her head. A staff member's hand comes into the foreground and holds the patient's hand for reassurance.

Close-up of the touchscreen control panel on the front of a scanner, where the glowing start button dims as the scan is set up. A patient lies on the table inside the bore, out of focus in the background.
A woman in a navy gown lies back on a padded table with her arms raised behind her head and looks upward, appearing to be positioned for a scan. The camera moves slowly towards her.

A female patient in a navy gown lies on her back with her arms raised behind her head, eyes open and calm, as she is positioned for a scan in an imaging room. A contrast injector unit with lit controls stands out of focus in the background.
A female patient in a navy top lies on a scanner table with her arms raised above her head as she slides into the purple-lit scanner bore for a scan.

Overhead view of a female patient lying on her back with her eyes closed and arms raised above her head inside a scanner bore, likely an MRI. The bore's ambient lighting shifts from red to orange during the shot.
Detail of the Siemens Healthineers logo on the curved white housing of a scanner in the imaging department, with focus softening and returning across the shot.

A staff member in a three-piece suit stands by the reception desk at The Harborne Hospital and gestures toward the patient waiting area as the camera moves right to reveal the lounge seating, artwork and a wall-mounted information screen.
A slow move across the ground-floor lobby of The Harborne Hospital, past cream leather sofas, armchairs, artwork and steel lift doors, ending on two people seated and reading in the waiting area.

A man in a three-piece suit stands in the reception and waiting area of The Harborne Hospital, then gestures toward the lounge seating as the camera moves past him to show sofas, armchairs, artwork and a wall screen with consultant photos.

An empty hospital corridor with framed abstract artwork along the wall, wood doors and an emergency exit sign at the far end. The camera moves left to reveal a wall-mounted wayfinding sign.

sentences.text: A nurse in a navy uniform opens a door and steps aside as the camera moves through the doorway into an empty private patient room at The Harborne Hospital, with a made bed, bedside monitor, armchair and large window.
